name: @intellectual-frontiers/scanners
description: Runs security scanners (a built-in TLS and header check, nuclei, nmap, trivy, grype, semgrep, checkov and ZAP's baseline scan) the safe way: only after the engagement allows the action, only a binary whose SHA-256 is the one pinned for it, with a command line made from validated parts and no shell, in an empty working folder with a bare environment, and a record of every run. What they print is read into findings.

scripts.verify: tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun ../tools/mizan-check.ts --root spec-kit && bun ../libraries/src/check.ts --root spec-kit --level L1 && bun ../kanon/src/check.ts && bun tools/check.ts && bun test suite/
